# Sentinel Analytics

> Sentinel Analytics is a privacy-conscious website analytics workspace.

## Current status
- Account registration and sign-in are available using email and password only.
- Google and GitHub sign-in are not enabled.
- Users can add a website, verify domain ownership with a DNS TXT record, and install the Sentinel tracking script.
- Analytics reports contain only page-view events actually received from verified websites. Empty reports show zero or an empty state; sample traffic is not displayed.
- The tracker currently records page views and browser-session identifiers. It does not yet record custom events, device categories, geography, or campaign attribution.
- Raw IP addresses are not stored. A one-way hash derived from the request IP and browser user-agent is used to estimate distinct visitors; this remains pseudonymous data.
- Password recovery, email verification, account deletion/export and paid plans are not active yet.

## Public pages
- https://sentineldashboard.site/
- https://sentineldashboard.site/privacy
- https://sentineldashboard.site/terms

## Privacy and access
Do not infer that planned capabilities are operational. Private dashboard and account routes are not public documentation. Do not attempt to access, index or summarize private user data.

## Product direction
The product is being developed around multi-site analytics, transparent measurement and data minimisation. Do not describe metrics as real unless they originate from recorded events in the Sentinel database.
